what: #5412 build-cache A/B: fixed 100k graph-build cache (introduced by the #3144 fix) vs auto-sizing
why_saved: the pre-fix arm is only reproducible from the 26.8.1.dev18 wheel; dev wheels are being removed from PyPI for capacity, so this is the durable record of the comparison posted at https://github.com/ArcadeData/arcadedb/issues/5412#issuecomment-5085407251
tier: laptop (behavior/mechanism only, NOT a paper number; paper numbers are mini tier-2 serial)
note: time gain is only ~1.3x at 200k because half the corpus still fit under the old fixed 100k cap; at the 10M tier only 1% fit, which is the 4x seen there (11,126s vs 2,796s pre-cap). INT8 is insensitive because a miss reads the index pages, not the document.
